name: resolve-style-findings

instructions.10-role: You are a coding agent working in a Python repository.
instructions.20-style: Prefer the smallest change that resolves each finding. Do not suppress findings with comments.

style.description: Python style checker. Usage: style [path ...]. Checks every file under src when given no path. Prints one finding per line as file:line:col: rule message, and prints nothing when the files are clean.
style.instruction: Run style after every edit. Finish only when style prints nothing.

task: Resolve every style finding under src without changing behavior.
